newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two Mexico crude port still shut - port authorities.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexico crude port still shut - port authorities.

text.p: Two key Mexican crude shipping ports remained shut as of 0830 local/1430 GMT Wednesday because of strong winds, port authorities told Reuters.
Pajaritos in Veracruz state and Dos Bocas in Tabasco state closed at 1400 local/2000 GMT Tuesday, and winds at Pajaritos were reported Wednesday at between 70 and 80 km per hour.
A Dos Bocas port spokeswoman who declined to be named said winds were calm and the port could reopen at midday.

Mexico's main crude shipping port, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained open Tuesday and Wednesday as the port's more eastern Gulf of Mexico site protected it from a cold front that struck the region.
The latest figures from state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) estimate Cayo Arcas ships 600,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, Pajaritos 400,000 bpd and Dos Bocas 300,000 bpd.
A total of eight ports were reported closed along the shores of the Gulf of Mexico by the Communications and Transport Ministry.
